description: RBA curve nodes for an exact date or the latest publication: cash and bond yields as published, and the RBA's fitted zero, forward and discount curves (each point says whether it is observed or derived), with optional exact comparison date, instrument details, source digest and convention. Eight distinct cash/government families; no intraday OIS, BBSW, swap or futures feed. Zero/forward fitted data publish monthly.

date.description: Exact observation date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for latest. No silent carry-forward.

name: yield_curve
